cover.explanation: This is a bug fix that restores the documented contract for context_length: docs/api/openai.md on main defines the field as the number of tokens the model can handle in one request, but the base branch reports the raw aggregate ctx_size, which overstates per-request capacity when llama.cpp runs multiple non-unified slots (per issue #3574). The PR's per-slot computation (ctx_size / --parallel, --kv-unified-per-slot cap, GGUF training-context cap, and the same semantics for the auto-context fallback) turns the already-present field into the right answer, so no RFC or working-group charter is required.

surfaces.by: docs/api/openai.md on the base branch (models list/retrieve field descriptions, line 1045): 'context_length - Number of tokens the model can handle in one request. Uses the loaded value when the model is running and the configured ctx_size otherwise (omitted when neither is known).' The base branch already reports this field from ctx_size (already present in base-branch source) but copies the raw aggregate value, which contradicts the per-request semantics under --parallel/--no-kv-unified, as documented by the failure in issue #3574 (surface marked was: failing); deriving per-slot capacity from that same ctx_size, capped by --kv-unified-per-slot and the GGUF training context, and applying the same semantics to the auto-context fallback makes the endpoints deliver what the docs already promise.

explanation.body: The title, body, and template claims describe what the diff does.
explanation.diff: The diff adds backends::llamacpp::per_request_context_length (src/cpp/server/backends/llamacpp/llamacpp_server.cpp) and routes llamacpp models through it in Server::resolve_context_length (src/cpp/server/server.cpp), so context_length now reflects per-request slot capacity: non-unified KV is divided by --parallel, unified KV is capped by --kv-unified-per-slot, and everything is capped by the GGUF max context window; the auto-context fallback gets the same slot semantics. test/server_endpoints.py adds test_006aa covering these cases. The body matches the diff: it fixes #3574's aggregate-KV reporting, changes no names, defaults, or formats, and touches no docs.
explanation.quality: Checked docs/api/openai.md (the model list field reference that documents context_length), docs/api/lemonade.md, and docs/guide/configuration/llamacpp.md: only openai.md describes the field, and its 'loaded value / configured ctx_size' wording is now untrue for llamacpp, whose loaded and configured paths both run through the new per-slot partitioning. For tests, test_006aa_context_length_accounts_for_llamacpp_slots ships in test/server_endpoints.py, which the Test endpoints steps of cpp_server_build_test_release.yml run on Ubuntu, Windows, macOS, and the arm64 matrix, and it asserts exact partitioned values (4096/2048/16384 vs raw 8192/32768 pre-fix) that the PR body confirms failed on main. Docs to do: Add a note on per-slot ctx_size partitioning for llamacpp to the context_length field in docs/api/openai.md.
